title: 'Say It with a Kiss' cut from the movie

blocks.x: I don't know why. They gave it this --
Yes. It was a beautiful tune.
Must've been too good for them.
There's an album out called -- what do you call it? "Cut." It's an album --
It contains a lot of things that were cut from the movies. And I was on a show with Joe Franklin a few years ago, and he had it and he played it.
It sounded good before with my voice high at that time -- I was younger.
So, I supposed then, there should be something added to your discography around this time.
